description: The bar chart illustrates correlation values for three domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across four labeled measures shown in the legend: Pop\_GT, Pop\_Ge, RPop\_GT, and RPop\_Ge. The horizontal axis contains the categories Movies, Songs, and Basketball in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Correlation” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. For each category, four adjacent bars are grouped together: Pop\_GT is shown as a solid light-orange bar, Pop\_Ge as a hatched light-orange bar, RPop\_GT as a solid blue bar, and RPop\_Ge as a hatched blue bar. In Movies, the bars are approximately 0.22 (Pop\_GT), 0.10 (Pop\_Ge), 0.35 (RPop\_GT), and 0.64 (RPop\_Ge). In Songs, the bars are approximately 0.30 (Pop\_GT), 0.09 (Pop\_Ge), 0.49 (RPop\_GT), and 0.70 (RPop\_Ge). In Basketball, the bars are approximately 0.07 (Pop\_GT), 0.09 (Pop\_Ge), 0.13 (RPop\_GT), and 0.22 (RPop\_Ge). The bars are not shown as stacked, there are no visible error bars or annotations, and the category order does not appear to be sorted by bar height.
